extracted.intended_audience: journalists, editors and producers at Al Jazeera (and similar newsrooms)
extracted.subtask_description: A newsroom code of ethics and editorial standards for journalists and editors producing news, features and live coverage; specifies core values, newsworthiness criteria, editorial stance and procedural expectations. Emphasizes truth-seeking, diversity, independence and sensitivity in reporting, with a companion Code of Conduct for specific activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Honesty, courage, fairness, balance, independence, credibility and diversity
rubrics_metrics.description: Core journalistic values; no priority to commercial or political over professional.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These values are primary and should guide editorial decisions; commercial or political considerations must not be given priority over professional standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Endeavour to get to the truth and declare it
rubrics_metrics.description: Endeavour to get to the truth and declare it in dispatches/programmes/news bulletins unequivocally with no doubt about validity and accuracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report facts with clarity and certainty where warranted; avoid language that undermines the validity or accuracy of verified information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treat audiences with due respect
rubrics_metrics.description: Address every issue with attention to clarity, factuality, and accuracy; treat audiences with due respect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give consideration to: feelings of victims of crime, war, persecution, disaster; their relatives; viewers; individual privacies; public decorum. Be mindful of tone, language and presentation to avoid gratuitous offense.

rubrics_metrics.name: Present diverse points of view without bias or partiality
rubrics_metrics.description: Present diverse points of view without bias or partiality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actively include multiple perspectives and avoid privileging a single viewpoint; ensure fair representation of dissenting or marginalized voices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledge and correct mistakes promptly
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When errors occur, issue corrections openly and quickly to maintain credibility; follow internal correction procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Truth-seeking as primary (newsworthiness)
rubrics_metrics.description: Truth-seeking is the primary criterion for newsworthiness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritise stories and reporting approaches that advance factual understanding and uncover truthful information over sensationalism or agenda-driven content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fairness and balance in framing (newsworthiness)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fairness and balance in framing are central to editorial decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame stories so that relevant sides are represented and context is provided; avoid framing that skews perception without justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence from commercial and political pressure
rubrics_metrics.description: Independence — editorial decisions must be free from commercial or political pressure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain separation between newsroom judgment and external influences such as advertisers, sponsors, or political actors; declare and manage conflicts of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity of perspectives, especially Global South / non-Western
rubrics_metrics.description: Prioritise diversity of perspectives, with special attention to Global South and non-Western viewpoints.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actively seek sources and narratives outside dominant Western frames; amplify marginalized and regionally specific perspectives to correct imbalance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sensitivity to victims and relatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Be sensitive to the feelings and dignity of victims and their relatives in coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exercise care in interviewing, imagery, and descriptions involving victims; avoid re-traumatisation and gratuitous intrusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy considerations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Weigh public interest against intrusion; protect private information unless disclosure is justified for news value or public safety.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultural appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure reporting and presentation are culturally appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of cultural norms, sensitivities and context; avoid misrepresentation or culturally insensitive framing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial courage — willingness to cover difficult stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Exhibit editorial courage by covering difficult, controversial or sensitive stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not shy away from important public-interest reporting because it is uncomfortable or contentious; ensure rigorous standards when covering such stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voice for the voiceless
rubrics_metrics.description: Give a voice to the voiceless — prioritise marginalized perspectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proactively feature stories and sources from marginalized communities and those typically excluded from mainstream narratives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Counter-dominant narratives
rubrics_metrics.description: Advance counter-dominant narratives, especially regarding Western framing of the Middle East.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Challenge dominant or hegemonic framings where appropriate by providing alternative contexts and histories; avoid uncritically reproducing external narratives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Long-form documentary tradition
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain a tradition of long-form documentary reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invest in in-depth, longer-form storytelling and documentary work that explores issues beyond immediate headlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Live, immediate coverage from conflict zones
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide live, immediate coverage from conflict zones.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritise on-the-ground reporting for timeliness and direct observation while balancing safety, accuracy and ethical considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to companion Code of Conduct
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the Code of Conduct companion document outlining specific journalistic activities, audience relations, and source relations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult and comply with the companion Code of Conduct for procedural rules, detailed guidance on interactions with audiences and sources, and role-specific responsibilities.
